judged_text: addMembers silently succeeds when some or all submitted usernames do not match any user, returning success_json with nothing added and no indication of which names were skipped. An admin typos 'johm' instead of 'john', gets a green success response, the member list reloads unchanged, and the admin has no way to know the add failed — membership drifts silently.

adjudication.rationale: In Admin::GroupsController#add_members, usernames are split and each is looked up with User.find_by_username; non-existent usernames are simply skipped (no else/collection of failures). The action then renders success_json as long as group.save succeeds, even if zero users were added, and the client Group#addMembers just reloads the list without surfacing any skipped names. This is a real diff-grounded validation/UX gap, but not a hard correctness failure (state remains consistent).
